purpose: Mandatory business/runtime context resolved before visual reference selection or page code.

tenancy: Store/channel/tenant scope is a design input, not an implementation detail.
Caller-visible navigation never widens backend authorization.
Exact-record actions must resolve current authorized scope again on the server.
money: Display currency from authoritative record/config/domain data; do not hard-code a currency label merely to style a page.
Preserve domain precision and rounding rules; client UI does not invent financial precision.
Do not perform client-side FX or infer settlement/payment success from formatting.
assets: Use production brand assets and the current icon family; screenshots are reference material, not runtime assets.
Product/store imagery remains server/CDN driven where the product contract says so.
Do not bake translated copy into image assets for dynamic product UI.
lifecycle: High-growth data requires bounded pagination/load-more or an explicit bounded-data contract.
Polling/subscriptions stop when the surface no longer needs them and reconcile on resume according to the owning contract.
Stale retained data is labelled and cannot masquerade as live.
